grammarRequirements: Use mostly simple and compound sentences with some controlled complex sentences
Use clear pronoun references and explicit logical connectors
Keep tense changes purposeful and easy to follow

requirements: Make unfamiliar words understandable from context

distractorRules: Use plausible misunderstandings of the passage rather than unrelated statements
Keep options similar in length and grammatical form
Do not use trick wording, all-of-the-above, or none-of-the-above
Ensure only one option is defensibly correct
prohibitedContent: instructions for dangerous or illegal acts
promptInstructions: Create a self-contained passage with a clear structure, age-appropriate subject matter, and enough explicit evidence to support every question.
